scope: Cloud performance optimization and necessary compatibility repair; synthetic fixtures only
changes: Post-upload readback stages verified bytes for the coordinator; managed files are not downloaded again. Final stable listing and durable Verified transition remain required.
HTTP downloads overlap in groups of at most four files and 32 MiB advertised raw size; larger files run alone. CM plans stay serialized and every reader is owned by the operation future.
Normal preflight activates ownership early and captures after reading remote state. Pending recovery retains the early capture; disabled/offline launches retain their capture.

Identical SHA-256/size archive entries are checked once per manifest validation. Remote cache candidates with wrong size or duplicate content identity are skipped. No integrity result is cached across transitions.
Known obsolete pending statuses in schema 1 and 2 journals are migrated while preserving operation IDs, manifests and may_have_committed. Invalid status/unknown fields leave journals unchanged.

final_workspace.note: Final run includes the last size-prefilter change and one added archive-corruption regression; full macOS build/tests completed afterward.
